capabilities: Hide or show the frontmatter of the current file from a ribbon control
Collapse or expand frontmatter via a clickable strip above the YAML block
Run vault-wide commands to hide, show, collapse, or expand frontmatter in all notes
Remember per-file display states across renames and deletions
Set a vault-wide default display state in settings
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not clean or format YAML; it only changes whether frontmatter is visible, collapsed, or hidden.
extras: Works in Source mode, Live Preview, and Reading view; makes no network requests and stores only display preferences in data.json. README includes developer release and submission instructions beyond user documentation.
problem: Obsidian always shows the frontmatter block in the editor, which can clutter notes when the YAML is not needed on screen.
summary: Display toggle that shows, collapses, or hides YAML frontmatter in notes without editing any content.
